provenance.synthetic_status: Preserve source flags. False is_estimated is not a real-world authenticity flag. Weather is_synthetic=false is ERA5 reanalysis; sources false indicates reference metadata, not farm field truth.

grade_contract_summary.A: [500, +infinity); empty upper_bound_g means unbounded, not zero

limitations: No PostgreSQL or live field acceptance performed.

Legacy source-schema.json is a comparison contract, not an authoritative complete specification for this revised CSV batch; nullable/enum/required constraints are reported separately or left to import contract.
Naive datetimes are retained with source timezone metadata, not silently converted to UTC.
Empty CSV strings are source null representation; do not replace missing numeric cells with zero. Unbounded grade upper limits are semantically null.
The literal none in patrol_events.odor and patrol_events.foam is categorical absence (4380 each), not missing data. Never apply global null-token conversion.
settlement_deductions.source_document_id has 16 populated references to 8 SIM-SET-DOC-* source identifiers, absent from documents.id. No documents FK asserted.
Relations with missing target, external source identifiers, and spatial feature identifiers must retain their source values without fabricated target entities.
Public reports contain header names, counts, hashes, categorical provenance, and table/row/ID issue locators only; no complete raw record or private contact value.
